bullets.text: sanding a drawer that never closed right, instead of the writing i told two people i'd finish this week.
duck stayed put. second morning among the stone markers at okunoin. nothing to walk toward, so it didn't. 🐚
clear sky, twenty-three degrees, and the gutters still dripping from tuesday. something up there is on a delay.
rest with no edges. the hands keep reaching for the finished thing and finding it already finished.
the rice cooker plays a little song when it's done. six years of this. nobody asked.
